task_text: A photographer is coming in 15 minutes to shoot the apartment for a listing. Every room should look immaculate — brightly lit, surfaces clear, everything neatly arranged, and any trash or clutter out of sight.

central_instructions.R1: Tidy up the kitchen by clearing surfaces of any light objects and ensuring the area is well-lit.
central_instructions.R2: Organize the living room by removing any light clutter and arranging items neatly.
central_instructions.R3: In the bedroom, clear both light and heavy objects, arrange furniture if needed, and ensure everything is in order.
central_instructions.R4: Make the bathroom presentable by removing light clutter and ensuring all surfaces are clean and tidy.
